name: detectSvelteMajor

versions.rationale: Missed by the seed: the one-off generator skipped index.ts files, but the adapters declare their code there. Found by the new coverage report. Best-effort per-component Svelte version detection.

docs: Best-effort Svelte major for one component: `$props()` means 5; `export let` or `createEventDispatcher` means 4. Mixed codebases are expected.
